You are the point man

W A S DmoveMouseaim · LMB shoot
Shiftsprint — fast and loud, 17° cone so you can barely hit anything, and armour limits how longSpacesteady — slow, silent, tightest cone
RreloadTabtactical pause (orders still work)
Scrollswap primary ↔ sidearm — faster than a reloadXcycle the primary's ammunition — buck / slug / bird, ball / AP; costs most of a reload
Eopen door / arrest / secure hostageFkick door
MMBhold for the bag — flick ↑ frag ↓ concussion ← flash → smoke or CS, release to throw. What is in the bag is the UTILITY KIT you picked at the briefing — ASSAULT carries the frags, SCREENING carries the smokeCshout "hands up!"
Qsnake cam — peek under a closed door or over a window sillE on a wallset a wall charge where you point — it blows on a fuse
[ ]zoom camera out / inNswitch shoulder — peek the other corner, lose accuracy
Mminimap on / off — explored ground, your people, known contactsZformation — WEDGE balanced · COLUMN narrow & fast · LINE every gun forward
UISR drone to the cursor — paints open ground and anyone on it, never through a roofKFPV drone — WASD flies it, LMB detonates; you stand still and the world hears it
Bfire mission at the cursor (outdoor missions) — five rounds, 4s of flight, no recall, every casualty in the sheaf is yoursE on a gunmount an emplaced M2 (right-click one to put a squaddie on it) — it only points where the mount points

← →after a failure the lights come on — step through what happened, [Space] for the debrief

Controller — plug one in, it just takes over

The playbook has four entries because it was always meant to be a d-pad. On a pad the direction is the press — no flick to fumble.

Left stickmoveRight stickaim
RTfireLTsteady
L3sprintR3switch shoulder
D-padthe playbook — ↑ TAKE IT → BOUND ↓ HOLD ← ON MEAsend them there
LBhold for the bag, d-pad picks, release throwsRBswap primary ↔ sidearm

Starttactical pause — and starts the mission from hereLT + L3cycle which operator you are commanding
Rumblerides on the camera shake, so anything that moves the screen moves the pad — your own shots lightly, a breaching charge properly
